title: China Price Check: Antelope Canyon $100, China's Rainbow Hills $15 | China Travel Expert
description:
Antelope Canyon: a guided slot-canyon tour runs about $100. China's rainbow mountains? About $15 at the gate.

Zhangye Danxia National Geopark in Gansu is a sea of striped sandstone hills — iron and minerals laid down and eroded over millions of years. The 2026 adult ticket is about ¥108 (~$15), and a shuttle loops you between the main cliff-top viewing platforms. A guided tour of Arizona's Antelope Canyon runs roughly $90–$135 plus a Navajo permit — same bucket-list color, very different price.

🧭 Expert Tip: come 1–2 hours before sunset — low light makes the reds and golds pop; midday washes the stripes flat.
